title: Four generations of horses in one tree
description: Nova's tree in Minecraft 26.3: eight founders, four foals, two grandchildren, and Nova. Vanilla AI bred every foal in an automated scene. The script tamed and named the founders and grew each foal up before the next generation.

title: Pan and zoom across the family
description: The same four generations in the tree screen. The camera moves are scripted, and the family came from vanilla breeding.

title: Two players and one family on a server
description: A Fabric 1.21.1 dedicated server with Family Tree 1.3.0 and viewPolicy=EVERYONE_ALL. Alex, with the mod, sees the tree screen. Kai, on unmodded Minecraft, uses /familytree. Taken after a server restart. The console summoned and named the wild wolves and grew Biscuit up; the players tamed and fed them, and vanilla AI bred Biscuit and Pepper.

title: Chest menus for players without the mod
description: Kai clicks Pepper to see its parents and grandparents, then opens Biscuit, Alex's wolf. Real clicks on an unmodded Minecraft 1.21.1 client.

title: The family as a written book
description: Page 2 of Pepper's family book on Kai's unmodded client: both parents and all four grandparent slots.

title: Other players' animals are view-only
description: Kai can open Alex's wolf, but the menu has no Locate, Rename, or Add parents. Only the owner or an operator can change an animal.

title: Did the foal beat its parents?
description: Ember jumps higher than both parents (green triangle) and has less health than either (red triangle). Automated 26.3 scene with vanilla AI breeding.

title: Vanilla horse breeding, recorded
description: Clover and Pippin eat golden carrots, vanilla AI breeds them, and the foal joins the tree. The script led the pair together and fed them.

title: Family details in Jade
description: Jade 26.3.5 on Fabric 26.3. Family Tree adds the name, parents, generation, and each stat beside the parents' values. Same automated scene.

title: Wool colors mix
description: A pink lamb from a white and a red parent. The player named and fed the sheep in an automated 26.3 scene, and vanilla AI bred them.

title: A brown panda from two carriers
description: Cocoa is brown because both parents carried the brown gene hidden. A separate run of the automated 26.3 scene; vanilla AI bred the pandas, and a name tag named the cub.

title: Tabs and variant search
description: Pets, Farm, and Wildlife tabs, then a search for blue. The blue axolotl was spawned blue for the scene and named with a name tag; it was not bred.

title: JourneyMap waypoint from the tree
description: Waypoint in Nova's tree added this JourneyMap waypoint where Nova stood. JourneyMap 6.0.10 on Fabric 26.3.

title: Four generations exported as a PNG
description: Nova's family exported from the tree screen, with each horse's speed, jump, and health. Exports leave out player names and coordinates.

title: Add known parents without commands
description: Choose two pets in the picker, review the selection, and confirm. This screen uses a staged example family.

title: Plan a foal before you breed
description: The breeding planner for Quill and Sorrel, two horses bred by vanilla AI in an automated scene in Minecraft 26.3. It names them half siblings, gives the foal's inbreeding coefficient, and lists each stat's lowest, most likely, and highest value with the chance to beat both parents, plus coat and marking odds.

title: Compare two horses, plan their foal, and find the best pairs
description: 9 seconds in Minecraft 26.3. Shift-click highlights how Quill and Sorrel are related, Plan breeding opens their foal's odds, and Best pairs ranks 24 horses bred over four generations by vanilla AI in an automated scene.
